description.zh:
表示返回的域名列表是否与证书精准匹配。

- true：开启
- false：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether the returned domain names must be an exact match for the certificate.

- true: enabled

- false: disabled

description.zh:
证书公钥。

需要先采用Base64编码，再进行encodeURIComponent编码，支持PEM格式。
description.en:
The public key of the certificate. The public key must be in PEM format. The value must be Base64-encoded and then encoded using \`encodeURIComponent\`.

The value must first be Base64-encoded and then \`encodeURIComponent\`-encoded. The PEM format is supported.

description.zh:
表示返回的域名列表只包含开启或关闭HTTPS的域名。

- true：开启
- false：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to return only domain names for which HTTPS is enabled or disabled.

- true: enabled

- false: disabled

descriptions.en: > A single user can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-by-certificate --ssl-pub xxx --ssl-status true --exact true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --SSLStatus true --SSLPub xxx --Exact true
